gloss: to spread throughout; to reach everywhere; to be well-distributed

definitions.gloss: to spread throughout; to reach every corner; to pervade
definitions.explanation: For something to be distributed or to extend to all parts or people without exception.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{教科書|きょうかしょ}が{全員|ぜんいん}に{行|い}き{渡|わた}った。
examples.english: The new textbooks were distributed to everyone.

examples.japanese: {情報|じょうほう}が{社内|しゃない}{全体|ぜんたい}に{行|い}き{渡|わた}るまで{時間|じかん}がかかった。
examples.english: It took time for the information to spread throughout the entire company.

examples.japanese: {電気|でんき}が{村|むら}の{隅々|すみずみ}まで{行|い}き{渡|わた}った。
examples.english: Electricity reached every corner of the village.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{行|い}き{渡|わた}る → {行|い}き{渡|わた}らない (negative)
・{行|い}き{渡|わた}る → {行|い}き{渡|わた}って (te-form)
・{行|い}き{渡|わた}る → {行|い}き{渡|わた}った (past)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {行|い}く (to go) + {渡|わた}る (to cross over)

The combination means to go across/through completely.

COLLOCATIONS:
・{全員|ぜんいん}に{行|い}き{渡|わた}る - to reach everyone
・{隅々|すみずみ}まで{行|い}き{渡|わた}る - to spread to every corner
・{情報|じょうほう}が{行|い}き{渡|わた}る - information spreads
・{目|め}が{行|い}き{渡|わた}る - to keep an eye on everything

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{普及|ふきゅう}する - to spread (ideas, technology)
・{浸透|しんとう}する - to permeate, penetrate
